A yaml example: parameters with step 1 'Choose the project type' (property isMobileSdk, title 'Is this a mobile SDK?', type boolean, default false) and step 2 'Fill in the details' (property name) with if (properties isMobileSdk const true, required [isMobileSdk]) then (properties sdkPlatform with enum android/ios and minimumOsVersion string, required both).
